code_behavior.declared_absolute_free_force_residual_li: Optional max_free_force_residual_n. When absent, group gate is inconclusive; when present, reported baseline/candidate free-force L2 and max-component residuals are checked against it.
code_behavior.regularization_floor: The fixed regularization floor is not scaled with dt; equal tolerance/dt does not establish equivalent solve error.
code_behavior.what_the_bound_means: A numerical bound on observed free-force residuals, not an absolute force-error bound or proof of discretization accuracy.

docs_vs_code: Current documentation describes the tightened relative tolerance and separate observed force-residual bound. It also states the tolerance ratio is not an absolute force-error bound. This is consistent with code; no constant-relative-tolerance correction was found in the source119 or current planner files.
native392_status: Source118 native baseline failed its first bent step with accepted_steps=0; this resource audit is not numerical convergence evidence.
